# `cos`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
cos(expr)
```

Returns the cosine of `expr`, as if computed by
`java.lang.Math.cos`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT cos(0);
```

Result:

```text
1.0
```
